annotations.text:
New direction — native iOS 26, after Kyo 2.0's approach
System-first: grouped grey ground, white inset lists with Settings-style coloured icon squares, SF text, and one expressive serif title face (New York) for page titles, like Kyo's custom title fonts. Each course gets a soft pastel tint with a matching dark ink and a subtle dot pattern instead of saturated gradients. Today is a colour-coded vertical timetable with dashed breaks. Navigation is Liquid Glass: floating glass buttons at the top, a floating glass tab bar with a separate search button at the bottom within thumb reach. The exam opens as a standard sheet with a grabber.
All values are sample data. Dark mode toggle above each frame.
